name: knowledge-forest-mcp
description: Local-first personal knowledge and learning memory for AI tutors.
long_description: Turn learning goals into prerequisite-aware knowledge trees, reuse concepts across goals, preserve notes and evidence across chats, and require novel closed-book performance before claiming mastery. Knowledge Forest runs locally, stores portable JSON, sends no telemetry, and never calls an LLM.

tools.name: forest_overview
tools.description: See goals, progress, mastery counts, and ready work.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Find canonical knowledge nodes that can be reused across goals.

tools.name: get_node_context
tools.description: Read a node's relationships, notes, evidence, and diagnosis.

tools.name: diagnose_node
tools.description: Identify prerequisite, depth, and evidence gaps.

tools.name: get_learning_queue
tools.description: Find ready and prerequisite-blocked learning nodes.

tools.name: create_goal_tree
tools.description: Create a minimal prerequisite-aware learning goal tree.

tools.name: update_node_learning_state
tools.description: Update learning depth or non-mastery workflow state.

tools.name: append_learning_note
tools.description: Append notes, sources, reflections, or exercises.

tools.name: record_verification
tools.description: Record evidence and enforce the closed-book mastery rule.

tools.name: export_forest
tools.description: Export the complete portable knowledge forest.
